description: Judge one seat's answer by its call id, once you have checked it against the source. One per seat you judged. List the claims it got right in `real` and the claims that are untrue in `false`, one sentence each: they feed routing and the 'confidently wrong' record, so a note alone is not enough.

call.description: The seat's call id, e.g. p20261022-101500-ab12.member1.

false.description: Claims it made that are untrue, one sentence each.

note.description: One or two sentences on why.

real.description: Claims it made that are true, one sentence each.

name: verdict
title: Record a verdict
